reviews.text: We had a great time; the puppies returned home feeling safe and in great shape after their stay. Highly recommended! Thanks to the attentive and helpful staff, who sent me photos and summaries of their daily activities.

I left my Golden Violetta at the boarding kennel run by Anna Maria, and I couldn't have made a better choice. She's a very helpful person, and you can immediately see how much she cares for the animals that stay with her.
What I appreciated most was seeing how attached she became to Violetta and how she treated her as if she were her own. She cared for her with so much love, patience, and attention, sending me videos and photos, making me feel at ease and worry-free.
She was also incredibly helpful in recommending an excellent supplement for Violetta's arthritis, demonstrating once again her attentiveness and sincere interest in the well-being of the animals she cares for.
Thank you so much, Anna Maria, for the care and affection you've given my Violetta. I absolutely recommend this boarding kennel to anyone looking for a reliable, loving person who is truly passionate about their work. See you soon, Violetta and Lucrezia. 🐾❤️

We've been Anna Maria's clients for many years, ever since 2013, when we adopted our Labrador Cindy. From the very beginning, she helped us train her with great skill, patience, and love.

Over the years, we've continued to rely on her for boarding and dog sitting, always with the utmost peace of mind and trust, knowing that Cindy was in excellent hands. Cindy has always loved being with her and has also created a special bond with her beloved Tommy and Bicio Billy: a relationship built on affection, balance, and great harmony. 💛

We've always appreciated her professionalism, expertise, availability, and the deep dedication she puts into her work every day.

A few months ago, Zeus, a Corso-like dog, joined our family, and Anna Maria is once again guiding us in his training with great expertise. She's helping us not only with training, but also with weight management to prevent future joint problems, which is crucial for large dogs.

We feel supported in everything, with care and sensitivity.

We've trusted her for so many years and wouldn't change her for anything in the world ❤️

We recommend her wholeheartedly! 🐾

I've known Annamaria for about a month. I've found her to be an excellent professional, and my furry friend has been very happy with her.
She gave me so much good advice.
It's clear that it's not just a job, but a passion and love for animals.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars – Absolutely Exceptional Dog Sitting Service!

We cannot recommend (AnnaMaria) Dog Sitter Dog House Rome highly enough! We have trusted her with our beloved Maltese, Nico, for the past six years, and every experience has been perfect. Her professionalism, reliability, and genuine love for dogs are unmatched.

For our wedding in July, her support went far beyond ordinary dog ​​sitting. Knowing that Nico would be bringing the wedding rings, she took the time to review the location in advance to ensure everything would run smoothly. She kept Nico calm, comfortable, and completely at ease throughout the entire event. Thanks to her expertise in dog behavior—truly second to none—Nico performed beautifully.

What we appreciate most is how always available she is and how she constantly keeps us updated with photos and videos, letting us know exactly how Nico is doing. It gives us total peace of mind every time he stays with her.

Nico is always so happy when he's there, and seeing how well she knows him after all these years is incredibly reassuring.

Highly, highly recommended!

*************************************

We met Anna Maria in 2018, during a difficult time for our friends, both dogs and cats. Her invaluable advice helped us immensely, and her care was invaluable for our furry friends. Her high level of training, extensive experience, and unparalleled professionalism and compassion have never been compromised. Now, our cat Birillo has become our second mother.

I turned to Anna Maria for help finding my lost cat Lucrezia. She supported me not only with valuable practical advice but also with psychological support, keeping my spirits high and encouraging me not to lose hope. So much so that I finally found her even before she could come in person to help me search, just as she had predicted.

Thank you so much ❤️
